test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Abduct
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e.** 'Redeem'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given word **"Abduct" **means to take someone away illegally, especially using force.(अपहरण करना)
 
• **"Redeem"** means to compensate for the faults or bad aspects of something or to gain or regain possession of something in exchange for payment.(पुनः प्राप्त करना)</li&g
